While these intervals capture a wide range of probable outcomes, specific, high-impact events could push the actual results beyond these stated bounds. These include unforeseen "black swan" events such as a sudden global financial crisis, an abrupt and extreme shift in central bank policy, or a major geopolitical conflict escalating unexpectedly.
